title: The step chain's read steps take an EmDash kit: CMS line, primary menu labelled by position, menu labels kept out of the contract mapping
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: An EmDash kit gets its own CMS line in front of the locked prompts; its main menu is the content map's primary menu with label slots named by position (dropdown children under their parent), a plan page no item opens is a problem, and the copy export keys words by content map key with the menu labels left out of the contract mapping; the WordPress main menu reads as before.

tests: a WordPress kit gets the WordPress line, a Joomla kit the Joomla line, an EmDash kit the EmDash line
an EmDash kit's main menu is its content map's primary menu, labelled by position
a dropdown child the plan keeps is a slot under its parent; one it does not keep is hidden
a plan page no menu item opens is a problem, never a guessed slot
the EmDash export keys words by content map key and leaves the menu labels to step 9
